conflict: The exact sequenced voucher is explicitly labelled Japan (K. Yonekura 6788, PE01523822), but the currently accepted C. verutum species concept has no native Japanese range. This is therefore a voucher/taxon-concept contradiction, not merely a missing-photo problem.

required_next_evidence: Inspect PE01523822 / K. Yonekura 6788 directly, including determination history and any updated annotation.
Determine whether the Japanese material was cultivated, misdetermined as C. verutum, or represents a taxonomic concept not equivalent to the currently accepted Himalayan-to-Indochinese species.
Only after specimen-level taxonomic reconciliation decide whether a Japan-local colour phenotype can be joined to JPN_29.

claim_boundary: This gate establishes a real contradiction between an explicitly Japanese voucher label and the accepted native range. It does not reidentify the sequence or prove the voucher label is wrong. Until specimen-level determination history is resolved, JPN_29 may remain in the raw nuclear reconstruction but must not be used as a clean Japan-local colour-history tip.
